description.en: Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Kafka's ATK to a one designated enemy.
description.zh-CN: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于卡芙卡#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害。

summary.en: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.
summary.zh-CN: 对敌方单体造成少量雷属性伤害。

description.en:
Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Kafka's ATK to a target enemy and Lightning DMG equal to #3[i]% of Kafka's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
If the target enemy is currently receiving DoT, all DoTs currently placed on that enemy immediately produce DMG equal to #2[i]% of their original DMG.
description.zh-CN:
对指定敌方单体造成等同于卡芙卡#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，同时对其相邻目标造成等同于卡芙卡#3[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害。
若指定敌方单体处于持续伤害状态，其当前承受的所有持续伤害立即产生相当于原伤害#2[i]%的伤害。

summary.en:
Deals Lightning DMG to one enemy and minor Lightning DMG to adjacent targets.
If the primary target is currently afflicted with a DoT effect, the DoT deals DMG 1 extra time.
summary.zh-CN:
对敌方单体造成雷属性伤害，对相邻目标造成少量雷属性伤害。
若主目标处于持续伤害类负面状态，则使持续伤害类负面状态额外产生1次伤害。

description.en:
Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Kafka's ATK to all enemies, with a #2[i]% base chance for enemies hit to become Shocked and immediately take DMG from their current Shock state, equal to #5[i]% of its original DMG. Shock lasts for #3[i] turn(s).
While Shocked, enemies receive Lightning DoT equal to #4[i]% of Kafka's ATK at the beginning of each turn.
description.zh-CN:
对敌方全体造成等同于卡芙卡#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，有#2[i]%的基础概率使受到攻击的敌方目标陷入触电状态，并使其当前承受的触电状态立即产生相当于原伤害#5[i]%的伤害。触电状态持续#3[i]回合。
触电状态下，敌方目标每回合开始时受到等同于卡芙卡#4[i]%攻击力的雷属性持续伤害。

summary.en:
Deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies, with a high chance of Shocking them.
If the enemies are currently Shocked, the Shock status deals DMG 1 extra time.
summary.zh-CN:
对敌方全体造成少量雷属性伤害，大概率施加触电状态。
若敌方目标处于触电状态，则使触电状态额外产生1次伤害。

description.en: After Kafka's teammate uses Basic ATK on an enemy target, Kafka immediately launches Follow-Up ATK and deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of her ATK to that target, with a #2[i]% base chance to inflict Shock equivalent to that applied by her Ultimate to the attacked enemy target, lasting for #3[i] turns. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per turn.
description.zh-CN: 当卡芙卡的队友对敌方目标施放普攻后，卡芙卡立即发动追加攻击，对该目标造成等同于卡芙卡#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，并有#2[i]%的基础概率使受到攻击的敌方目标陷入与终结技相同的触电状态，持续#3[i]回合，该效果每回合只能触发1次。

summary.en: After a teammate uses Basic ATK on an enemy, Kafka immediately launches Follow-Up ATK and deals Lightning DMG with a high chance of inflicting Shock to that target. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per turn.
summary.zh-CN: 当队友对敌方目标施放普攻后，卡芙卡立即发动追加攻击，对该目标造成雷属性伤害，并有大概率施加触电状态。该效果每回合只能触发1次。

description.en: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
description.zh-CN: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

summary.en: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
summary.zh-CN: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

description.en: Immediately attacks all enemies within a set range. After entering battle, deals Lightning DMG equal to #3[i]% of Kafka's ATK to all enemies, with a #1[i]% base chance to inflict Shock equivalent to that applied by her Ultimate on every enemy target for #2[i] turn(s).
description.zh-CN: 立即攻击一定范围内的所有敌人，进入战斗后对敌方全体造成等同于卡芙卡#3[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，同时有#1[i]%的基础概率使敌方每个单体目标陷入与终结技相同的触电状态，持续#2[i]回合。

summary.en: Attacks all enemies within range. After entering battle, deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies, with a high chance to Shock them.
summary.zh-CN: 攻击范围内的所有敌人，进入战斗后对敌方全体造成少量雷属性伤害，大概率施加触电状态。

description.en: Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Kafka's ATK to one designated enemy.
description.zh-CN: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于卡芙卡#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害。

summary.en: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.
summary.zh-CN: 对敌方单体造成少量雷属性伤害。

description.en:
Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Kafka's ATK to one designated enemy and Lightning DMG equal to #3[i]% of Kafka's ATK to adjacent targets.
If the designated enemy or the adjacent targets are currently afflicted with DoT, all DoTs currently placed on those enemies immediately produces DMG equal to #2[i]% or #4[i]% of the original DMG.
description.zh-CN:
对指定敌方单体造成等同于卡芙卡#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，同时对其相邻目标造成等同于卡芙卡#3[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害。
若指定敌方单体或相邻目标处于持续伤害状态，其当前承受的所有持续伤害立即产生相当于原伤害#2[i]%或#4[i]%的伤害。

summary.en:
Deals Lightning DMG to one enemy and minor Lightning DMG to adjacent targets.
If the attacked targets currently have any DoT inflicted on them, the DoT additionally produces 1 instance of DMG.
summary.zh-CN:
对敌方单体造成雷属性伤害，对相邻目标造成少量雷属性伤害。
若攻击目标处于持续伤害类负面状态，则使持续伤害类负面状态额外产生1次伤害。

description.en:
Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Kafka's ATK to all enemies, with a #2[i]% base chance for enemy targets hit to become Shocked and immediately take DMG from their current DoT debuff(s), equal to #5[i]% of the original DMG. Shock lasts for #3[i] turn(s).
While Shocked, enemy targets receive Lightning DoT equal to #4[i]% of Kafka's ATK at the beginning of each turn.
description.zh-CN:
对敌方全体造成等同于卡芙卡#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，有#2[i]%的基础概率使受到攻击的敌方目标陷入触电状态，并使其当前承受的持续伤害类负面状态立即产生相当于原伤害#5[i]%的伤害。触电状态持续#3[i]回合。
触电状态下，敌方目标每回合开始时受到等同于卡芙卡#4[i]%攻击力的雷属性持续伤害。

summary.en:
Deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies, with a high chance of Shocking them.
If the enemies are currently afflicted with DoT debuff(s), the DoT(s) will produce 1 additional instance of DMG.
summary.zh-CN:
对敌方全体造成少量雷属性伤害，大概率施加触电状态。
若敌方目标处于持续伤害类负面状态，则使持续伤害类负面状态额外产生1次伤害。

description.en: After Kafka's teammate uses an attack on an enemy target, Kafka immediately launches Follow-Up ATK and deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Kafka's ATK to the primary target, with a #2[i]% base chance to inflict Shock (equivalent to that applied by her Ultimate) on the attacked enemy target for #3[i] turns. This effect can trigger up to #5[i] time(s), #4[i] of which can be regained at the end of Kafka's turn.
description.zh-CN: 当卡芙卡的队友对敌方目标施放攻击后，卡芙卡立即发动追加攻击，对主目标造成等同于卡芙卡#1[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，并有#2[i]%的基础概率使受到攻击的敌方目标陷入与终结技相同的触电状态，持续#3[i]回合。该效果最多可触发#5[i]次，卡芙卡回合结束时恢复#4[i]次。

summary.en: After a teammate uses an attack on an enemy target, Kafka immediately launches Follow-Up ATK and deals Lightning DMG to the primary target, with a high chance of inflicting Shock. This effect can trigger up to 2 time(s), 1 of which can be regained at the end of Kafka's turn.
summary.zh-CN: 当队友对敌方目标施放攻击后，卡芙卡立即发动追加攻击，对主目标造成雷属性伤害，并有大概率施加触电状态。该效果最多可触发2次，卡芙卡回合结束时恢复1次。

description.en: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
description.zh-CN: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

summary.en: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
summary.zh-CN: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

description.en: Immediately attacks all enemies within a set range. After entering combat, deals Lightning DMG equal to #3[i]% of Kafka's ATK to all enemies, with a #1[i]% base chance to inflict Shock (equivalent to that applied by her Ultimate) on every enemy target for #2[i] turn(s).
description.zh-CN: 立即攻击一定范围内的所有敌人，进入战斗后对敌方全体造成等同于卡芙卡#3[i]%攻击力的雷属性伤害，同时有#1[i]%的基础概率使敌方每个单体目标陷入与终结技相同的触电状态，持续#2[i]回合。

summary.en: Attacks all enemies within range. After entering combat, deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies, with a high chance to Shock them.
summary.zh-CN: 攻击范围内的所有敌人，进入战斗后对敌方全体造成少量雷属性伤害，大概率施加触电状态。

description.en: When the Talent triggers a Follow-Up ATK, there is a 100% base chance to increase the DoT received by the target by 30% for 2 turn(s).
description.zh-CN: 天赋触发追加攻击时，有100%的基础概率使目标受到的持续伤害提高30%，持续2回合。

description.en: While Kafka is on the field, DoT dealt by all allies increases by 25%.
description.zh-CN: 卡芙卡在场时，我方全体造成的持续伤害提高25%。

description.en:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
description.zh-CN: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

description.en: When an enemy target takes DMG from the Shock status inflicted by Kafka, Kafka additionally regenerates 2 Energy.
description.zh-CN: 当敌方目标承受的由卡芙卡造成的触电状态产生伤害时，额外为卡芙卡恢复2点能量。

description.en:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
description.zh-CN: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

description.en: The Shock state inflicted on the enemy target by the Ultimate, Technique, or the Talent-triggered Follow-Up ATK has a DMG multiplier increase of 156% and lasts 1 turn(s) longer.
description.zh-CN: 终结技、秘技与天赋触发的追加攻击使敌方目标陷入的触电状态的伤害倍率提高156%，并使触电状态的持续时间增加1回合。

description.en: When the Ultimate is used, enemy targets will now receive DMG immediately from all currently applied DoT sources instead of just receiving DMG immediately from the currently applied Shock state.
description.zh-CN: 施放终结技时，敌方目标由「其当前承受的触电状态立即产生伤害」变更为「其当前承受的所有持续伤害类负面状态立即产生伤害」。

description.en: If an enemy is defeated while Shocked, Kafka additionally regenerates #1[i] Energy.
description.zh-CN: 触电状态下的敌方目标被消灭时，卡芙卡额外恢复#1[i]点能量。

description.en: The base chance for target enemies to be Shocked by the Ultimate, the Technique, and the Talent-triggered Follow-Up ATK increases by #1[i]%.
description.zh-CN: 终结技、秘技与天赋触发的追加攻击使敌方目标陷入的触电状态的基础概率提高#1[i]%。

description.en: When an ally target's Effect Hit Rate is #1[i]% or higher, Kafka increases that target's ATK by #2[i]%.
description.zh-CN: 我方目标效果命中大于等于#1[i]%时，卡芙卡使该目标的攻击力提高#2[i]%。

description.en: If an enemy target is defeated while Shocked, Kafka additionally regenerates #1[i] Energy.
description.zh-CN: 触电状态下的敌方目标被消灭时，卡芙卡额外恢复#1[i]点能量。

description.en: After using Ultimate, restores the triggerable count of Talent's Follow-Up ATK by 1. And the Talent's Follow-Up ATK can cause all DoTs debuffs currently on the target to immediately produce DMG equal to #1[i]% of the original DMG.
description.zh-CN: 施放终结技后恢复1次天赋的追加攻击可触发次数，且天赋的追加攻击可以使目标当前承受的所有持续伤害类负面状态立即产生相当于原伤害#1[i]%的伤害。
